accountability_matrix.model_owner: Lead ML Research Engineer (responsible for code integrity, reproducible builds, and split hygiene)
accountability_matrix.safety_officer: Clinical Safety Officer (responsible for consequence matrix, threshold sign-off, and claim boundaries)
accountability_matrix.governance_lead: Information Governance Lead (responsible for privacy compliance and audit logs)

transparency_protocol.explanation_guarantee: Every inference produces twin grounded explanations (Class influence vs Routing risk) before action.
transparency_protocol.rule_checker: Rule-based regex engine verifies that outputs contain zero ungrounded clinical claims or diagnosis promises.
transparency_protocol.audit_logging: Immutable DecisionRecord captures model weights, thresholds, input values, and component scores.

privacy_and_security.network_isolation: Inference and web UI run strictly on IPv6 loopback (::1). Zero external network egress.
privacy_and_security.data_persistence: Zero database or disk storage of patient intake responses. Ephemeral memory-only execution.
privacy_and_security.phi_minimization: System collects no direct identifiers (name, date of birth, NHS/MRN number).

lifecycle_management.drift_monitoring: Anomaly Isolation Forest acts as an in-line sentinel for covariate shift.
lifecycle_management.recalibration_triggers: Model requires re-benchmarking if validation risk distribution drifts by >10% Wasserstein distance.
lifecycle_management.decommissioning_criteria: Retire model immediately if data source is deprecated or hardware scanners change imaging physics.
